children: Overview
Italy luxury menswear group's H1 2026 revenue up 6% yr/yr to €987 mln
Adjusted EBIT rose to €74.5 mln, beating analyst expectations
Profit fell to €28.4 mln from €47.9 mln due to absence of prior-year non-cash gains
Outlook
Company says macroeconomic and geopolitical environment remains uncertain
Ermenegildo Zegna to focus on sustainable and profitable growth
Result Drivers
DTC CHANNEL GROWTH - Group said double-digit growth in direct-to-consumer channel drove H1 performance, with DTC now 86% of branded revenues
ZEGNA SEGMENT MARGIN EXPANSION - Co attributed improved Zegna segment margin to operating leverage, higher revenues per square meter and improved sell-through
WHOLESALE DECLINE - Group said streamlining of wholesale channel led to 14.6% YoY decline in wholesale revenues
